final_message: The compiled artifact now models the full patch mechanism — iteration-local net_device allocation inside the loop, error-exit branch (goto to label outside the loop), leak when the then-branch lacks free_netdev of the still-owned allocation, with null-guard silence for the allocation-failure check and register_netdev ownership-transfer silence for later error branches — so only implementation/functional gates remain.
